grammar_focus: it 作形式主语 + for sb + to do / how 从句(it is hard for us to realize how…)、must have done(对过去的推测)、过去分词作定语(cut off / accustomed to / washed down)、定语从句(that/which / such…as)、被动语态各时态(is admired / had never been attained / was attained)(NCE4 无 KS 页,考点由课文结构自取;原创承载·论早期登山先驱以登顶为唯一目标、不像今人求难度,及阿尔卑斯山村的贫寒·题材无害;美语化 backpack/vacation;第四册第3课)
scene: 如今的登山者专挑最难的路线,而且越难就越受推崇。可在早年间,情形完全不是这样。先驱者寻的是登顶最容易的路,因为顶峰本身才是他们想要的奖赏——尤其是那种从未被人征服过的顶峰。长久无人能上的马特霍恩峰,便是其中最大的奖赏。诚然,那些早期登山者在远征途中常遇到极其凶险的危难,身上的装备简陋得会让今天的登山家不寒而栗;可他们并不刻意去招惹这种风险。他们只有一个目标、唯一的一个目标——登顶。今天的我们很难体会,那些先驱当年的处境有多艰难。除了策马特和夏蒙尼这样一两处迅速热闹起来的地方,阿尔卑斯的村庄都是贫穷、偏远的聚落,被高峰隔绝于世界之外。仅有的那几家客栈往往肮脏不堪;吃的不过是本地奶酪和面包,常常就着劣酒咽下。一条山谷里常常连一家客栈也没有,登山者只得随处找地方过夜——有时投宿村里的神父家(神父往往和他的教民一样穷),有时借宿牧人处。到处的底色都一样:肮脏、贫困、生活艰苦。对于住惯了舒适家宅的人,搬到这些一贫如洗的山谷,那份落差一定让人极难适应。可他们还是年复一年地来,因为一座无人登临过的顶峰,值得忍受任何不适。

grammar_card.title: it 形式主语 + how 从句 / must have done / 过去分词作定语 / 被动各时态
grammar_card.intro: ①it 作形式主语,真正主语是不定式,执行者用 for sb 引出:It is hard for us to realize how…;后可接 how 从句。②must + have + 过去分词,对过去作推测“一定…了”。③过去分词作定语=被动/完成:cut off from the world; men accustomed to comfort。④定语从句 that/which;such…as“…这样的”。⑤被动语态各时态:is admired(现在)/ was attained(过去)/ had been attained(过去完成)。

rows: It is + 形容词 + for sb + to do
It is hard for us to realize…
the change must have been hard
villages cut off from the world

specialRules.rule: it 形式主语句里,动作的执行者用 for sb 引出(不用 of sb):It is hard for us to do。
过去完成的被动=had + been + 过去分词:had never been attained before。
美式用词:backpack(背包,英式 rucksack)、vacation(假期,英式 holiday)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was the main objective of early mountain climbers?
options: To reach the summit, especially one never climbed before
To find the most difficult route

passage: Modern climbers seek out mountains by the hardest route they can find, and the more difficult the climb, the more highly it is admired. In the early days it was not like this at all. The pioneers looked for the easiest way to the top, because the summit itself was the prize they wanted, especially if it had never been attained before. The Matterhorn, unclimbed for so long, was the greatest prize of all. It is true that on their expeditions those early climbers often met dangers of the most perilous kind, equipped in a way that would make a modern alpinist shudder; but they did not go out of their way to court such risks. They had a single aim, one solitary objective — the top. It is hard for us today to realize how difficult things were for those pioneers. Except for one or two places, such as Zermatt and Chamonix, that had quickly grown popular, the Alpine villages were poor, remote settlements, cut off from the world by the high peaks. Such inns as there were tended to be dirty; the food was little more than local cheese and bread, often washed down with rough wine. Often a valley boasted no inn at all, and climbers took shelter wherever they could — sometimes with the village priest, who was usually as poor as his neighbors. Everywhere the background was the same: dirt, poverty, and hard living. For men accustomed to comfortable homes, the change to these impoverished valleys must have been hard indeed. Yet they came, year after year, because a summit that no one had yet reached was worth any discomfort.

grammar_points.name: it 作形式主语 + for sb + to do / how 从句
must have done(对过去的推测)
过去分词作定语(cut off / accustomed to)
被动语态各时态(is/was/had been done)

stage5.stem: "___ is hard for us to realize how tough their life was."(it 形式主语,填代词)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们很难体会他们的生活多么艰苦。

stage5.stem: "It is hard for us ___ realize how difficult it was for them."(it 形式主语,真正主语是后面的不定式,填不定式符号)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们很难体会那对他们有多难。

stage5.stem: "It was hard ___ the pioneers to find a decent inn."(it 形式主语句:动作的执行者用哪个介词引出)
stage5.stem_cn: 对先驱者来说,找一家像样的客栈很难。

stage5.stem: "The change to those poor valleys ___ have been hard for them."(对过去的推测“一定…”,填情态词)
stage5.stem_cn: 搬到那些贫穷的山谷,对他们来说一定很难熬。

stage5.stem: "The first climbers ___ have suffered greatly on the way up."(对过去的推测,填表推测的词)
stage5.stem_cn: 最早的登山者上山途中一定吃了不少苦。

stage5.stem: "Reaching the summit must ___ felt like a triumph."(must ___ 过去分词:对过去的推测,填这个助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 登上顶峰一定感觉像大获全胜。

stage5.stem: "The villages were poor settlements, ___ off from the world."(过去分词作定语,被动“被隔绝”)
stage5.stem_cn: 那些村子是与世隔绝的贫穷聚落。

stage5.stem: "Men ___ to comfortable homes found the valleys hard."(过去分词作定语,“习惯于…的”)
stage5.stem_cn: 住惯了舒适家宅的人觉得山谷难挨。

stage5.stem: "The bread was ___ down with rough wine."(过去分词,被动“被…送下”)
"The summit was the prize ___ the climbers wanted most."(定语从句,指物,作宾语)
stage5.stem_cn: 顶峰是登山者最想要的奖赏。

stage5.stem: "They faced dangers ___ would make us shudder."(定语从句,指物,作主语)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们面对的危险会让我们不寒而栗。

stage5.stem: "Such inns ___ there were tended to be dirty."(such … ___ 结构:‘…这样的’,填与 such 呼应的词)
stage5.stem_cn: 仅有的那些客栈往往很脏。

stage5.stem: "The harder the route, the more it ___ admired today."(一般现在时的被动,填 be 动词单数)
stage5.stem_cn: 路线越难,如今就越受推崇。

stage5.stem: "The peak had never ___ attained before their climb."(过去完成的被动:had never + ___ + 过去分词,填中间的词)
stage5.stem_cn: 在他们登顶前,那座峰从未被征服过。

stage5.stem: "The Matterhorn was finally ___ in 1865."(一般过去时的被动:was + 过去分词,填过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 马特霍恩峰终于在1865年被征服。

stage5.stem: "The highest point of a mountain is its ___."(“顶峰”用哪个词)
"Full of danger and risk means ___."(“危险的”用哪个词)
"A person who is among the first to do something is a ___."(“先驱”用哪个词)
